responsibility: Implements the predicate and condition system used for context-sensitive IPA summaries. It manages clause sets, adds and merges conditions derived from parameters and value ranges, remaps predicates across inlining, and streams predicate state for passes such as IPA-CP and the inliner.
same_name_distinction: Implements the executable logic behind ipa-predicate.h’s predicate model: clause insertion/combination, predicate evaluation and remapping across duplication/inlining, condition uniquing, and LTO stream_in/stream_out, rather than defining the predicate/condition types and APIs.
